audit: v0.4.0 — MUC 1: image gen (ImageFX API + UI fallback)
code: cmdImageGen shipped & wired: `image gen --prompt ... [--count N] [--ratio landscape|portrait|square] [--out DIR] [--json]`. Engine order: (1) ImageFX backend API `aisandbox-pa.googleapis.com/v1:runImageFx` using the labs session access_token — works headless, returns base64 PNGs; (2) UI fallback on labs.google/fx/tools/image-fx with network-level image capture.

authHunt.probe: session API + tokeninfo + live ImageFX call
authHunt.result: session API returns 200 with user + access_token (expires 2026-07-02T16:51Z) BUT the token is server-side revoked: google tokeninfo says 'Invalid Value', aisandbox returns 401 UNAUTHENTICATED on every call (fetchUserRecommendations, credits, runImageFx). UI: account chooser shows the account as 'Signed out' -> pwd challenge.
session error ACCESS_TOKEN_REFRESH_NEEDED (expired 2026-07-01), tokeninfo Invalid Value, ImageFX 401.

authHunt.probe: full copy -> whoami, labs sign-in flow (2 rounds), youtube.com, notebooklm.google.com
authHunt.result: Cookie DB holds SID/__Secure-1PSID/LSID valid ~398 days on disk, but Google invalidated the session server-side: youtube.com shows Sign-in button (signedIn:false), labs sign-in ends at accounts.google.com/v3/signin/rejected, NotebookLM redirects to account chooser. The yt-forever-keeper itself is crash-looping (see youtube-cli/yt-forever-keeper.log).
Same SID family as v2 profile plus labs next-auth session-token (30d). These are the same server-revoked credentials — no fresher session exists anywhere on the VPS.

authHunt.probe: cookie DB scan for google.com SID cookies
authHunt.result: No Google session cookies at all (Suno-only profiles).

conclusion: Every Google credential on the VPS traces back to the same account session that Google revoked server-side (~2026-07-02 morning, matching the moment the yt keeper started crash-looping). All paths end at signin/rejected or the pwd challenge. Per hard rule (no password entry, no brute force), MUC 1 E2E is BLOCKED-auth. Unblock: on a real signed-in browser, sign in at labs.google/fx/tools/flow once, export the profile/storage-state to the VPS, rerun `./bin/labgoogle image gen ... --json`.
